title: Pardons William E. Henry
description_short: Trump granted a presidential pardon to William E. Henry as part of a clemency list.
description_medium: The Justice Department lists William E. Henry among the pardons granted on January 19, 2021. It identifies his Middle District of Alabama case as theft of government property and records two years’ probation with a $4,000 fine, imposed on May 2, 2019, in its public clemency table.
notes: The linked DOJ listing gives the offense and original sentence but omits the underlying conduct, clemency terms, and documented rationale.

title: Commutes Sentence of Theodore E. Suhl
description_short: Trump commuted the sentence of Theodore E. Suhl as part of a clemency list.
description_medium: The Justice Department’s July 29, 2019 commutations list names Theodore E. Suhl, convicted in the Eastern District of Arkansas. It records an 84-month prison term, three years of supervised release, and a $200,000 fine for honest-services wire fraud, federal-program bribery, and Travel Act offenses, per the official table.
notes: The linked DOJ listing gives the offense and original sentence but omits the underlying conduct, clemency terms, and documented rationale.
